name: Dirty Pipe
description: A flaw was found in the way the flags member of the new pipe buffer structure was lacking proper initialization in copy_page_to_iter_pipe and push_pipe functions in the Linux kernel.

name: Dirty COW
description: A race condition was found in the way the Linux kernel's memory subsystem handled the copy-on-write (COW) breakage of private read-only memory mappings.

name: PwnKit
note: This is a pkexec vulnerability, not kernel, but often bundled in kernel-like checks. Usually fixed in updated polkit packages.
description: A local privilege escalation vulnerability was found on polkit's pkexec utility.
